title: THC's Ore Borders
description: Adds a special outline around all ores. Increases the ability to spot ores in caves.
body:
![THC's Ore Borders](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/24ae020665ff3d65508af6f25051a0a645479215.png)

This pack adds ore borders so that while caving you can detect ores from farther away.
